## Summary

Describe the user-visible result in a few sentences.

## Scope

- [ ] This change stays within the requested files and behavior.
- [ ] Unrelated working-tree changes are not included.
- [ ] Public claims match checked-in behavior and evidence.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Include anything not run and why.

## Data and security

- [ ] No credentials, private paths, transcripts, databases, or generated
      artifacts are included.
- [ ] Any network, installer, release, or data-retention change is documented.
